How long does 1-90 take in MoP Classic?

MoP Classic is on patch 5.5.3, Siege of Orgrimmar. The Escalation patch on 31 March 2026 applied the 5.3 XP reduction, so levels 85-90 now need 64,990,000 XP instead of 97,500,000 - a third off the most expensive stretch in the game. The full 1-90 run is 95,883,400 XP, and Pandaria is still 67.8% of it.

1-90: hours to cap by play style, no XP bonus active
Play styleCasualAverageOptimized
Questing~54 h~32 h~20 h
Dungeon grinding~47 h~28 h~18 h
Mixed~50 h~30 h~19 h
PvP~97 h~58 h~36 h

MoP is also the only live version with real XP stacking: heirloom chest and shoulders for +20%, the guild perk Fast Track for +10%, and rested on top. That is why a prepared player with heirlooms lands near the commonly reported 25 hours rather than the 32 the base questing numbers show, and why 85-90 on its own comes out around 8-9 hours.

It is also the one version where dungeon grinding beats questing outright, at roughly 28 hours against 32, because Dungeon Finder removes the travel and group-forming time that makes dungeon spam expensive in Classic Era.

XP bonuses available

An XP bonus never changes how much XP a level costs - it changes how fast you earn it, so a +20% bonus cuts roughly 17% off the time rather than 20%. These are the bonuses that apply in this version.

XP bonuses in MoP Classic
BonusValue
Rested XP (typical play)+15%
Heirloom chest + shoulders+20%
Guild perk: Fast Track+10%
Joyous Journeys buff, if it returns+50%

The two rested options describe the same buff at different intensities, so they never stack with each other - ticking one unticks the other. Everything else adds together. See how the numbers work for what sits behind the XP/hour rates.

Frequently asked questions

How long does 1-90 take in MoP Classic?

1-90 is 95,883,400 XP, of which 64,990,000 is levels 85-90 alone. Questing with no XP bonus is roughly 54 hours casual, 32 hours average and 20 hours optimized. With heirlooms and rested a prepared player lands nearer the commonly reported 25 hours, and 85-90 on its own is about 8-9 hours.

How much XP is 85 to 90 in MoP Classic?

64,990,000 XP since the Escalation patch applied the 5.3 reduction on 31 March 2026, down from 97,500,000. That is 67.8% of the entire 1-90 run packed into five levels.

Do heirlooms stack with rested XP in MoP Classic?

Yes. Heirloom chest and shoulders give +20% combined, the guild perk Fast Track adds +10%, and rested stacks on top of both. Only the two rested options in the calculator are mutually exclusive, because they describe the same buff at different intensities.

Is the Joyous Journeys XP buff still active in MoP Classic?

Not right now. The +50% Joyous Journeys buff ran from 21 April 2026 until Siege of Orgrimmar released in early June 2026. The checkbox is still in the calculator so you can model what happens if Blizzard turns it back on.
